title: Build a Stronger Freight Brokerage
description: A free, 53-minute training with Luis Uribe on positioning your brokerage, selling solutions to shippers and focusing on the activities that build lasting customer relationships.

registration.consentText: By registering, you request a confirmation email with your training-page link.

learningPoints.title: Position your brokerage around value
learningPoints.description: Compare the discount and premium brokerage models, and learn how freight selection, margins and customer needs shape your business.

learningPoints.title: Sell a strategy, not just a truck
learningPoints.description: Explore ways to help shippers through route planning, cost comparisons and transportation options that solve their real problems.

learningPoints.title: Focus on the work that matters
learningPoints.description: Prioritize building your shipper list, calling prospects, growing your carrier network and creating repeatable processes.

challenges.title: Competing only on price
challenges.description: You want customers to understand the value you bring beyond a cheaper rate.

challenges.title: Sales calls that go nowhere
challenges.description: You need a more useful conversation than asking whether a shipper has a load available.

challenges.title: Too many distractions
challenges.description: You want to choose the activities that deserve your attention as you build your brokerage.
